name: Tony Flick
biography: has been working in the Information Security field for more than 6 years. As a security consultant, Mr. Flick has assisted numerous organizations in achieving compliance with federal regulations and industry standards. His expertise includes risk management and compliance, assessments and audits, and research in emerging technologies. Mr. Flick has previously presented at the OWASP Tampa local chapter on application security concepts.
